title: Legora for in-house teams: Webinar recording
summary: Teach the Agent how you work. Skills let legal teams encode their standards, processes and preferences inside the Legora aOS™.
body_markdown:
In the past year, Legora grew its employee base by more than 5x, expanded from 3 to 18 offices, completed multiple acquisitions, and is now serving far more customers. Each milestone brought new complexity, risk, and pressure for a lean in-house legal team.


In this session, General Counsel Emma Kadri Bergström shares how her team uses Legora day to day across commercial work, in-house M&A, and compliance monitoring. Then Adrian Parlow and Walter Myer walk through what’s ahead for in-house teams — including a live look at agentic intake — with time for audience questions.


### What this webinar covers


During the presentation, we address how the legal operating model for in-house teams requires rethinking existing workflows around AI, and why speeding up individual tasks is insufficient. This includes a deep dive into the following topics:


-


How Legora’s legal team applies Legora to commercial contracting, in-house M&A, and horizon scanning


-


Where agentic legal work is headed for in-house teams — skills, automations, deeper integrations, and intake


-


How intake can meet the business where it already works (Slack, Teams, email), and the how different use cases can be handled with a lawyer in the loop for revisions, or automated, to streamline and accelerate delivery of routine work


### Learn more & take the next step


The session recording, including audience Q&A, is available below.
